gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-telug: Capture It towers on an enormous x-height, its letters pinched almost fully shut. Noto Sans Telugu is the release, counters staying connected to the outside and the midline set high.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-thai: Urban to the bone, Capture It packs a towering x-height and letters nearly sealed shut. Noto Sans Thai then loosens everything, its inflated, bead-like lowercase and open rounds making extended reading feel approachable.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-zanab: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars, with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. Beside Capture It, whose letters stay nearly sealed, the two feel like a closed fist next to an open hand.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-traditiona: Broad pen strokes that never curl shut, with bowls filling the line, make this body text feel unhurried. Noto Traditional Nushu would carry page after page without tiring, while Capture It stays tight and towering.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-oxygen: Capture It holds a tube-like thickness through every single bend. Oxygen leaves its curves unclosed, and that looseness against the sealed, towering heading is what makes the pairing click.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-parkinsans: Tall, tight and loud, Capture It towers over everything it touches. Parkinsans, wide-mouthed and crisp, opens up everything the heading keeps nearly sealed; that give-and-take is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-preahvihear: Bent-wire bluntness: Capture It towers, each letter shaped from a single length of wire and nearly sealed shut. Preahvihear, lofty and open-mouthed, pries the page back open beside it.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-prompt: Blunt and towering: Capture It never mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes in a word, and its openings stay nearly shut. Prompt handles the quiet work, with oversized small letters and open apertures.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-pt-sans-caption: Capture It shouts with a towering x-height and almost no openings. PT Sans Caption does the listening, with big-bodied lowercase and bowls left unclosed, so it is the one that actually invites you in.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-puritan: Capture It brings a towering x-height and letters pinched almost shut, a display heading with real urban muscle. Puritan keeps its rounded forms open, so pages of it go down smoothly.
